canonical_year_semantics: Animated Mufasa and The Lion King chronology only; it is not Darth Vader debut or James Earl Jones Vader voice-start chronology.

disney-remembering-james-earl-jones.page_title: Remembering Disney Legend James Earl Jones | The Walt Disney Company
disney-remembering-james-earl-jones.binding: The Walt Disney Company identifies James Earl Jones as the voice behind Darth Vader and Mufasa, dates the Vader role to A New Hope in 1977, and dates the animated Mufasa role to The Lion King in 1994.

starwars-james-earl-jones-vader.binding: Lucasfilm identifies Jones as Darth Vader's voice performer and separately credits David Prowse's physical performance, preserving the voice-versus-suit boundary.

d23-lion-king-1994-film.binding: The Walt Disney Archives fixes the original animated film to 1994 and lists James Earl Jones as Mufasa.

mufasa.selected_file_label: D23 caption-local 1994 animated Mufasa and Simba still
mufasa.caption: In a scene from Walt Disney Animation Studios' The Lion King, Mufasa relaxes in the grass as his son, Simba, chews on his ear. Stars twinkle in the sky above them.
mufasa.selection_ruling: The exact D23 archive object depicts the original 1994 animated Mufasa beside Simba, with Mufasa's face, mane, forelegs, torso, and paternal scene context legible. It excludes the 2019 photoreal character and later recast material.

vader.selected_file_label: D23 caption-local Empire Strikes Back Darth Vader still
vader.caption: In a scene from Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back, Darth Vader clutches his left hand as his cape billows in the wind.
vader.selection_ruling: The exact D23 Episode V object depicts the armored Darth Vader with helmet, mask, cape, chest controls, belt, torso, arms, and left-hand gesture legible. Lucasfilm's separate role receipt binds Jones only to the voice and credits David Prowse for physical embodiment.
